## Summary

Describe the behavior changed and why it belongs in the public repository.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests or validation evidence are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated only where the interface is public and stable.
- [ ] No secrets, private endpoints, real user data, or internal operational
      details are included.

## Design Boundary

- [ ] This change does not alter identity, Sync recovery, cryptography,
      Provider trust, FFI lifetime, audio realtime, or migration policy.
- [ ] Or, maintainer approval for the design-sensitive change is linked here.
